fields.title: goal: cap error continuation retries
fields.description: When an active /goal turn ends with an assistant error, tau currently treats the agent_end like normal progress and may dispatch another tau:goal-continuation follow-up. If the provider keeps failing, especially after tool work in the same agent_end, this can create an unbounded request loop and overwhelm the model service. Evidence: OpenAI context_length_exceeded / invalid_request_error surfaced during a goal continuation.
fields.design: At the goal adapter boundary, classify the latest assistant message in agent_end. Normal continuation is allowed only for non-error terminal assistant messages. Assistant stopReason=error enters a goal error-control path: record consecutive error state per session, fingerprint the error message, never send the normal continuation prompt for that agent_end, and coordinate with pi's existing auto-retry/overflow compaction by deferring immediate goal follow-ups. Retryable provider failures may get bounded goal-owned retries with exponential backoff only when the goal layer is responsible for the next follow-up; deterministic errors such as context_length_exceeded pause/suppress the goal instead of retrying. After three consecutive errors, pause or suppress the goal and notify the user with the last error and next manual step.
fields.acceptance_criteria: An agent_end whose latest assistant message has stopReason=error does not dispatch tau:goal-continuation immediately. Context overflow/context_length_exceeded does not trigger repeated goal follow-ups and leaves the user with a clear paused/suppressed state. Retryable provider errors are bounded to at most three consecutive goal-level attempts with exponential backoff and jitter. A successful non-error assistant turn resets the error counter. Existing pi interrupt behavior still pauses the goal and assistant stopReason=aborted without pi interrupt still does not pause the goal. Regression tests cover error-after-tool-call, three repeated provider errors, context_length_exceeded, and reset after success.
